chunks: Whatever is in it from Al-Hasan ibn Qarin, I have narrated it from Hamzah ibn Muhammad al-'Alawi—may Allah have mercy on him—from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Qarin.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: may Allah have mercy on him

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Hasan ibn Qarin in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-Hasan ibn Qarin. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material in the book.
